book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu yɛŋ kinchvu ki bamii le noo, wu mo wu ja wu bɛɛŋ wu gɛɛŋ wu shii yi mbegɛ le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo banyɛ bo to mbebe ye le.
Wu mo wu kɛ wu yɛyi bo wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba kee lɛ bo fuude yi kimbe ki Nyo le, nje bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le bvuboo.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba beede le, nje Nyo lé wu gê wu chiisɛ bo.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba jode bikwɛɛ biboo fɛkuu, nje bo lé bo gê bo ji kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba jɛŋ yuu bo le, kindoŋ yune bo kune kinche ki chaaŋ, nje Nyo lé wu gê bo fuu.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba koode yii fɛ bamu le, nje Nyo lé wu gê wu koo tɛ yii fɛ bo le.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba kɛme muntele mu yuude le, nje ba lé ba tɛ̂ŋe bo lɛ booŋ ba Nyo.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba too bɛ nyiɛgee le nje Nyo lé wu tɛ̂ŋe bo lɛ booŋ be.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba bo boone bikaa a bo jiŋ nje bo chee kinche ki chaaŋ, nje bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le bvuboo.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le kena, sege bamii naanyi bɛŋ, bo boone bikaa a bɛŋ jiŋ, bo jɛme kfuu chi mwɛɛ mù mbefe munchii kune bɛŋ yi achiji le, nje bɛŋ le bamii baŋ.
Fi doo fi kooshi noo bɛŋ mo bɛŋ lâŋeye, nje maajɛ wene wu kuge le woŋ wù fɛwe le. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ, le gɛh noo no bamii gɛ̀ boone bikaa ajiŋ a bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo ba gɛ̀ to fwe a bɛŋ le.

content: Bɛŋ le ŋka bɛ n'yuu wu yi woŋ kfunɛ le

content.text: Le bɛŋ ba le ŋka yi yi nshɛŋ yinɛ le. Geenɛ ŋka ja lo yi chii, ba ka ba ge nɛɛ bɛ yi fɛ yi ka yi kaasɛ yi jɛŋɛ? Gɛ taŋlo ba ka ba ge fiɛɛ fì joŋe bɛ yi gɛ fede lɛ ba noŋ lo bamii fede bo jiɛnyi bɛ bikaa.
Le bɛŋ tɛ ba le n'yuu wu yi woŋ kfunɛ le. Gɛ kilaantɛŋ kì ba jonɛ yi mbegɛ le, to ki nyiile gɛ.
Gɛ muh to wu chu tɛ kin'yesɛ wu ka wu jo ŋkaa wu kfuusɛ yu gɛ. Wu to wu tome nyume yi fiɛɛ fì ba toome kin'yesɛ fo, ki mo ki yɛ̂ne muh wuchii wù le yeh le.
Le gɛh tɛ yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no n'yuu wene kɛme ki wu bâaŋ a bamii jii, lɛ bo yɛde lɛme chena chì joŋe le bo nyaa mbɛɛŋsɛ Chiji wene wù le fɛwe le.
Keefɛ bɛŋ kwâji lɛ nto ki nchîijɛ mwɛɛ mù le a Ŋwa wu banchi ba Musɛ le gɛ, mo mù le a Baŋwa bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo le gɛ. Nto ki ŋge mu kojɛ lo. Gɛ nto ki nchiijɛ lo gɛ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛɛŋ bu no kibvulɛ bɛ nshɛŋ lé ki tô ki ka, gɛ fijise fi ŋwa a Ŋwa wu banchi le mo fi shige nɛɛ, nyume fi yu fi fe kuu njɛ fi kojɛ no fi chuunyi sɛŋ gɛ.

Fi mo fi nyu lɛ nɛ le yɛɛŋ wù bwɛɛdɛ nchi wumu a banchi banɛ le, wuwɛɛ nchi mo nyu wù shige nɛɛ lɛ, wu tu wu yɛyi bamii lɛ bo bwɛ̂ɛyi tɛ noo, tu mwɛdɛ lé wu gê wù nyu muh wù shige antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe. Geenɛ muh wù gɛɛde banchi banɛ, wu ka yɛyi tɛ bamii lɛ bo gɛ̂ɛde, tu mwɛdɛ lé wu gê wù nyu muh wù baaŋ antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe.
Noo, nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, nɛ gee chena chì chaaŋ fede gɛ chi bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo gɛ, mo chi Bafalashii lɛ, bɛŋ gɛ yu bɛŋ lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le gɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu wa ba duu bamii ba fweele le lɛ, ‘Keefɛ wo yûuyɛ muh gɛ! Nɛ muh yuuyi lo muh, tu wù kɛme nsa.’

Geenɛ njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ muh wuchii wù toonyi shɛ́ŋ bɛ mwa bwee, lé wù kɛ̂me tɛ nsa. Muh naŋ mwa bwee, wu kêe lɛ wu lé wu gê wu lɛɛŋ fwe a bamii ba sage bansa. Muh tɛŋe mwa bwee lɛ, ‘Kiyuŋ’ wu kee lɛ wu lé wu lêe ŋgu wù baaŋ le.
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, wo nɛ lɛme ki wo nyâ nnya yo fɛ kitana ki kintanyɛ le, wo kwajɛ lɛ mwa bwoo kɛme wo fɛ shɛŋ,
wo chinɛ nya yo le mbebe kitana ki kintanyɛ le, wo gɛɛŋ bena wu ya bɛŋ tu jwe wu mumwaa, fɛ wo kaasɛ wo to wo nya nnya yo.
Muh nɛ jo lo wo wu gɛɛne bɛ wo yeh yi nsa le, wo moŋ bena wu yaŋsɛ bɛŋ seesɛ baaŋ a je, fɛ wu nya wo chiaaŋ yi muh wù sage bansa le, wu feese wo chiaaŋ yi nchi le ba faa wo yeh yi ncha le.
Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ taŋlo wo bu yu njɛ wo mɛsɛ wo laŋɛ finini fichii fì ba goone sɛŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu wa ba duu lɛ, ‘Keefɛ wo jâŋ kwɛ muh gɛ!’
Geenɛ njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, muh wuchii wù jiiŋe kwɛse wù kɛme ŋkwajɛ wu kinjaŋ fɛ wu le, tu wu le wu jaŋ wa wu fɛ fitele le.
Nɛ jise chuŋ chì nchiɛɛŋ gee wo gee kimbefɛ, wo bvusɛ jise chiyu wo noŋ. Fi joŋe lɛ wo lɛsɛ kimbe kuŋ ki ye kimimia, fede fɛ ba ge ba noŋ ye yo yichii ŋgu wù baaŋ le.
Kibo kuŋ kinchiɛɛŋ nɛ gee tɛ wo gee kimbefɛ, wo suunɛ kibo kiyu wo noŋ. Fi joŋe lɛ wo lɛsɛ kimbe kuŋ ki ye kimimia, fede fɛ ye yo yichii gɛɛŋ ŋgu wù baaŋ le.

content: N'yɛyɛ kune ki muh kuŋ bɛ kwɛse

content.text: Ba gɛ̀ jɛmɛ tɛ lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh kuŋ lo bɛ kwɛɛ, tu wù kɛme ki wu sâŋ ŋwa wu nya kwɛse wuyu le, wù duunyi lɛ gɛ wu baaŋ kwɛɛ gɛ.’

Geenɛ njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, muh kuŋ lo bɛ kwɛɛ, nyume gɛ lɛ kwɛse wuyu le wu ge kinjaŋ gɛ, tu wu le wu ge lɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu tu kwɛse wu kinjikuu. Muh jo kwɛse wù bu a jwɛŋsɛ yeh wu gɛɛ a wu yeh, tu wu le wu jo kwɛ muh.

content: N'yɛyɛ kune ki muh jɛmɛ fiɛɛ wu kaŋ

content.text: Bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu wa tɛ no ba gɛ̀ jɛme bamii ba fweele le lɛ, ‘Sege wo jɛmɛ fiɛɛ wo kaŋ, keefɛ wo nyume njɛ wo ge fi sɛŋ gɛ. Wo kɛme ki wo gê fiɛɛ fì wo le wo jɛmɛ wo kaŋ a Tada fwe lɛ wo lé wo gê.’
Geenɛ, njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, keefɛ muh doo wu jɛme fiɛɛ wu kaŋ lo gɛ. Keefɛ wo kâŋ a jee chi fɛwe le gɛ, nje fɛwe le kala wu Nyo.
Keefɛ wo kâŋ nshɛŋ gɛ, nje nshɛŋ le kitege ki bikaa bi Nyo. Keefɛ wo kâŋ Yɛlusalɛm gɛ, nje Yɛlusalɛm le kilaantɛŋ ki Nfoŋ wù baaŋ.
Keefɛ wo kaŋ kikwɛɛ kuŋ gɛ, nje gɛ wo taŋlo wo fɛ yvu yimimia yi tu chibvuu kɛnɛ yi yiide gɛ.
Muh nɛ le wu bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ lɛ ‘Ɛɛŋ’, fi kojɛ noo. Wu tuŋ lɛ, ‘Aay’, fi kojɛ noo. Nɛ wu ka tale lo fiɛɛ fo, tu fiɛɛ fiyu ja fɛ muh wu kimbefɛ wɛɛ le.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu wa tɛ lɛ ba gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh bvuse jise chi muh, ba bvusɛ tɛ che. Muh baa kige ki muh, ba baa tɛ ke.’
Geenɛ, njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, keefɛ muh nyîide fiɛɛ bɛ muh wù befe gɛ. Nɛ muh le wu suŋ kinlaŋɛ kuŋ kinchiɛɛŋ, wo kaasɛ kiŋkoŋo wu mɛsɛ wu suŋ.
Muh some wo lɛ wu fi kikuŋ kuŋ kì antɛŋ, wo mɛsɛ wo nya mo kì akfuuŋ.
Muh kane wo lɛ wo jiɛnyɛ wo gɛɛŋ ma wu mumwaa, wo jiɛnyɛ wo bu mo bama bafɛɛ bena wu.
Muh lɛgɛ fiɛɛ a wo le, wo nya wu yu. Muh foo fiɛɛ a wo le, keefɛ wo fâŋ ki wo nyâ gɛ.

content: N'yɛyɛ kune no muh gêe bɛ muh we wu kimbanɛ

content.text: Bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu wa lɛ ba gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Wo kôŋe muh wù le mbebe yo le wo bâne muh wo wu kimbanɛ.’
Geenɛ, ntu njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, bɛŋ kôŋe bamii bena ba kimbanɛ, bɛŋ bûune fɛ ba boone bikaa a bɛŋ jiŋ le.
Noo, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ nyu booŋ ba Chiji wene wù le fɛwe. Le wu wù gee juu saane fɛ bamii ba befe le mo fɛ ba joŋe le. Wu gee tɛ jaŋ too fɛ bamii ba gee mwɛɛ mù chaaŋ le, mo fɛ bamii ba befe le.
Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ bɛŋ nɛ koŋe gɛh nyu bamii ba koŋe bɛŋ, maajɛ wuyu nyume la fɛ bɛŋ le? Gɛ bamii ba koode ŋwa gee tɛ noo gɛ?
Bɛŋ nɛ yɛɛse gɛh nyu booŋ ba bwee bena le, tu fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ gee fì bamii bamu gee gɛ le la? Gɛ bamii ba befe gee gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bɛŋ gee gɛ?
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ bɛŋ kɛme ki bɛŋ jôŋe bɛŋ gɛɛne bɛŋ mɛɛse no Chiji wene wu fɛwe joŋe wu gɛɛne wu mɛɛse.”

footnotes.text: Bamii ba fii kwa ba gɛ̀ yɛde lɛ le bamii ba befe.
